answer: Prayers & Duties >> Death & Funeral Question ID: 38568 Country: AF Title: I want to know weather a person gets the reward for 'sadaqah' given in his name after his death by his relatives or family Question: I want to know weather a person gets the reward for 'sadaqah' given in his name after his death by his relatives or family? Answer ID: 38568 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 892/730/B=1433) Yes, when sadaqah is given on behalf of a deceased person then its reward reaches to him/her, it is mentioned in hadith. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
